notes.title: Patch Notes for Ver.1.2.1
notes.content:
This update includes several bug fixes and adjustments based on player feedback. Thank you for your continued support!

Fixes and Changes:
　* Fixed a display issue where the item list in the Cheese Shed appeared misaligned.
　* Resolved an issue that prevented players from obtaining the "Small Punkin Gazo?".
　* Adjusted the conditions for accepting certain missions.
　* Corrected an issue where the unlock conditions for "Banner: Galphin" and "Banner: Dhorme" were reversed at Flower Land.
　* Fixed a bug where babies in beds would become invisible when dressed in the "Ihm Baby Suit".
　* Other minor bugs have also been addressed.

notes.title: (Resolved)Notice Regarding the Upcoming Ver. 1.2.1 Patch
notes.content:
We are currently preparing a patch (Ver. 1.2.1) to address the following issues that have been reported by the community.
We expect to deliver the update soon.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we finalize the release.

Planned Fixes:
* Misalignment in the item list display at the Cheese Shed.
* In rare cases, progressing with other missions before completing "Become a citizen" from Wiala may prevent players from obtaining a required fish, making some missions uncompletable.
* Unlock conditions for "Banner: Galphin" and "Banner: Dhorme" were mistakenly reversed.
* Babies in beds may become invisible when wearing the "Ihm Baby Suit".

notes.title: Patch Notes for Ver.1.1.0,Ver.1.1.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pmeONeUYQHo;full][/previewyoutube]
Ver.1.1.0
・Added new outfits, equipment, and interior items. Some can be purchased in in-game shops, while others unlock as you progress through the game and complete missions.
・Introduced the Auto-Gathering feature.
・Adjusted mission rewards to increase opportunities to obtain rare items such as "Timespace Crystal," "Enchantments," "Friend Binder," "Warp Stone," and "Hourglass of Remorse."
・Enabled directional keys for navigation in UI screens.
・Holding the B button while moving now allows the player to always walk.
・Added sorting and filtering options to certain shop menus.
・Pressing the "Guide Marker" button now displays "Work Points" and "Explorer Points" below "Money."
・Improved background pause functionality.
・Added an option to toggle "Background Pause" in the settings menu.
・Limited the ability to return to the title screen with the ESC key to the main screen and save screen to prevent unexpected issues.
・Fixed an issue where the school bulletin board's "School Points" list initially displayed "Explorer Points."
・Corrected an item name mistake where "Peridot" was incorrectly labeled as "Amethyst."
・Various other minor fixes and adjustments.

Ver.1.1.1
・Fixed an issue where some newly added "Enchantments" were not obtainable as quest rewards.

notes.title: Cloud Save Fix for Steam Deck
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! We have now addressed the following issues:
1. Cloud Save Fix for Steam Deck
	Save data should now upload to Steam Cloud properly.
2. Increased Backup File Limit
	The save backup limit has been increased to support more save slots.
We appreciate your support and hope this improves your experience on Steam Deck!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3034340/view/523081237389116213?l=english]Cloud Save Issue on Steam Deck[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Ver.1.0.3
notes.content:
- Modified the behavior of the ESC key during event scenes and endings so that the "Return to Title" confirmation window no longer appears.
- Corrected the positioning of sub-windows displaying acquired items and experience points on ultra-wide screens.
- Fixed the "Auto Select" function in the skill settings screen to work consistently.
- Changed the game to automatically pause when running in the background.
- Prevented the system screensaver and sleep mode from activating while the game is running.
- Fixed an issue where certain NPCs were missing specific skills.
- Applied various minor fixes and adjustments.

While these changes are not included in the current update, we are actively working on the following improvements for future releases:

-DLC Content
 Progress is being made, but it will take a bit more time before release.

-Mouse Support
 There are more technical adjustments than expected, so it may take some time before it's ready.

-Gameplay Restrictions & Balance Adjustments
 We are reviewing potential adjustments, and you can expect some balance changes in the next update.

-Background Pause
 The game now pauses when running in the background. In the next update, we plan to add an option to disable this feature.

-Walking at the Same Pace as NPCs
 In the next update, we plan to adjust L-stick responsiveness and add a feature that lets you walk consistently by holding the B button while using the L-stick.

notes.title: (Resolved)Cloud Save Issue on Steam Deck
notes.content:
We’re aware of the issue preventing cloud saves from working on Steam Deck and have been actively investigating and working on a solution. However, we’re currently unable to release the fix as we are still waiting for a Steam Deck device needed to verify the changes.

Without proper testing, there’s a risk of save data being lost, and we want to ensure the fix is implemented safely and effectively. We apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this issue as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: (Resolved)Skin Tone Issue and Upcoming Fix
notes.content:
We've received reports of an issue where character skin tones appear uneven at the start of a new game.

We've investigated this and found that while the genetic data for starting characters includes a variety of skin tones, this isn't accurately reflected in the characters' appearances.

We're working on a fix that will ensure character skin tones match their genetic data. This will be included in an upcoming update, and applying it will correct the skin tones of existing characters.

notes.title: Known Issues and Future Updates for WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea King
notes.content:
Thank you for playing WorldNeverland: Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom on Steam!

We are aware of some issues that players have been experiencing. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Japanese Text Input:
We are currently working on a fix for an issue causing problems with Japanese text input. Until the next update, we recommend using copy/paste or the virtual keyboard in Big Picture mode as a workaround.

Password Migration from Nintendo Switch:
We are planning to implement a feature that allows you to transfer your save data from the Nintendo Switch version to the Steam version in a future update for the Nintendo Switch.

Additional Content:
We plan to add additional content, such as the popular Challenge Dungeon from the Nintendo Switch version, to the Steam version in the future.

Importing Save Data from Smartphone:
While we are actively exploring the possibility of importing save data from the smartphone version, it is a complex issue due to technical limitations and the vast amount of data involved.

We are committed to providing the best possible experience for our players.
We will continue to update this community hub with the latest information, so please add the game to your wishlist.
